items.finding: Google's Ads Transparency Center lists 52 ads for exa.ai (all regions).
Of the 40 most recently shown ads, 22 are running now; 38 are search (text) ads and 2 are image ads.
4 search ads ran 274-321 days from mid-2025 until about 1 Oct 2026, when a new batch began: 22 ads started between 1 and 15 Oct 2026.

Search-ad headlines target category and use-case searches: "AI Search Engine", "Web Search API for LLMs", "People Search API - Phone Number Lookup API", "Deep Research API" and "An API, Not a Search Engine ... From $4/1k". One carries an "Exa vs Brave vs Perplexity" sitelink.
A brand search ad ("Exa Official Site - Exa Pricing and Plans") says the API is "Used in production at Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot and monday.com".
Meta ad data was not collected in this run. Use the library link to look.
The Exa Snapshot launch post on LinkedIn (17 Sep) links with utm_medium=paid and a "Multiply-ThoughtLeadership" campaign tag, so it was promoted as a paid post.
TikTok ads are link-only: the library mostly covers EU delivery, so we did not look.
Three plans: Starter (free, $10 of credits a month), Developer (pay as you go) and Enterprise (custom, "Talk to sales"). Search is priced from $4 per 1,000 requests.
Headline "The world's data for AI agents" with one main button, "Try API for free", which goes straight to the dashboard.
The sitemaps list 379 pages: 163 docs pages, 68 blog pages (34 updated in the last 90 days) and a 20-page data library.
10 "versus" pages and 9 "alternatives" pages (for example Brave Search API alternatives); 9 of the 9 alternatives pages were updated in the last 90 days.
56 integration pages in the sitemap.
Publishes an llms.txt (185 lines) and lets every major AI crawler in, including Meta's and Amazon's. Homepage structured data: Organization, WebAPI, WebPage.
A 10-post sample of @ExaAILabs on X (8-19 Oct 2026), with likes, reposts and replies.
A 9-post sample of CEO Will Bryk (@WilliamBryk) on X (6-19 Oct 2026), with likes, reposts and replies.
14 LinkedIn posts from the Exa company page (14 Aug - 12 Oct 2026) with reaction counts, found through Exa search.
The CEO says Exa "just passed $100m in annualized revenue", has "grown almost exactly 10x per year for 3 years" and handles "2 billion requests a month from 200k+ teams".
GitHub org exa-labs: 50 public repos with 8,545 stars; exa-mcp-server has 5,151 and company-researcher has 1,517.
Discord server "Exa" has 5,115 members (340 online when checked).
23 Hacker News stories link to exa.ai; the highest scored 46 points ("Exa-d: How to store the web in S3").
Reddit search was blocked (HTTP 403), so Reddit activity is unknown.

LinkedIn promotes a steady run of events: a Crunchbase webinar (12 Oct), a "GTM On the Edge" meetup in SF (7 Oct), an Aaru webinar (1 Oct) and a Gemini hack lab (Aug). The sitemap has 5 webinar pages.

Partnership launches on LinkedIn: Vercel marketplace and AI Gateway (26 Aug), an Exa plugin in Codex and ChatGPT (20 Aug), and Firefox's AI window (18 Aug). The pricing page lists an MCP server, a Claude Connector and a ChatGPT plugin.
The homepage loads Tolt, an affiliate and referral platform.
A rendered visit of the homepage loaded LinkedIn Insight Tag, Reddit Pixel, X (Twitter) Pixel, Common Room, RB2B, Google tag, Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, Tolt, Default, Sanity.
Hiring posts on LinkedIn (Head of Security, 3 Sep) and from staff ("Product team at Exa is hiring", 14 Oct).
Exa promoted an interview with 3Blue1Brown on its research vision (9 Oct).
YouTube was not collected in this run.
Review sites were not collected in this run.
Will Bryk's LinkedIn profile shows 11,547 followers.

posts.text: Exa 3.0, Exa Lite, upgraded highlights, and our expanded index are available today through the API. Read more: https://exa.ai/blog/exa-3
Exa 3.0 highlights make agents more accurate on search tasks, using 95% fewer tokens than full text.

We're also launching Exa Lite, our new search type at $4/1k, built for cost-sensitive apps.
Exa 3.0's gains come from upgrades across our retrieval stack, including our largest embedding model and Dynamic Highlights.
